wiki_article:
**Gravity Well: Suffusion Map — Room-by-Room Field Behavior** is a navigation map by Lee Sharks dated 6 April 2026, held in this record as a **metadata capture**.

The Gravity Well is the Hexagon's second field, and a suffusion map records how a nonlocal field behaves differently in each room it pervades — the practical companion to the field specification at #1348, which states the ontology. Where the specification says what kind of thing a field is, the suffusion map says what it does here, and here, and here.

The record was assembled from a DataCite full-metadata capture after the 19 June 2026 termination, with no live authorial surface passing the body-head gate at restoration time. The captured fields stand verbatim in the body.
